Class DCMotorSim

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.simulation.LinearSystemSim<N2,N1,N2>

public class DCMotorSim extends LinearSystemSim<N2,N1,N2>
Represents a simulated DC motor mechanism.

  • Constructor Details

    • DCMotorSim

      public DCMotorSim(LinearSystem<N2,N1,N2> plant, DCMotor gearbox, double... measurementStdDevs)
      Creates a simulated DC motor mechanism.
      Parameters:
      plant - The linear system representing the DC motor. This system can be created with Models.singleJointedArmFromPhysicalConstants(DCMotor, double, double) or Models.singleJointedArmFromSysId(double, double).
      gearbox - The type of and number of motors in the DC motor gearbox.
      measurementStdDevs - The standard deviations of the measurements. Can be omitted if no noise is desired. If present must have 2 elements. The first element is for position. The second element is for velocity.
